claims.claim: Ethiopian farmers used solar-powered irrigation systems introduced through Farm Africa’s Nature-based Solutions program.
claims.episode_span: Farmers in Ethiopia installed solar-powered irrigation systems through Farm Africa’s Nature-based Solutions for Sustainable and Inclusive Development program.
claims.source_title: Ethiopian Farmers Save Thousands by Switching to Solar Irrigation–While Cutting Emissions
claims.supporting_quote: Farmers in Ethiopia are slashing their growing costs, increasing food production, and protecting the environment thanks to solar-powered irrigation systems introduced through the Nature-based Solutions for Sustainable and Inclusive Development program led by the international nonprofit Farm Africa.
